answer: SELECT r.name, r.year FROM results res JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND res.rank IS NOT NULL AND res.rank > 0 ORDER BY res.rank ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM lapTimes lt JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Germany' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_germany FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'European Grand Prix';
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM results res JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId GROUP BY d.driverId ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';

SELECT forename, surname, (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', dob) AS INTEGER)) AS age FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Japanese' AND dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM results res JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId WHERE res.raceId = 872 AND res.time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.dob DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.name, res.points FROM results res JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' ORDER BY r.year ASC, r.round ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, AVG(ps.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS avg_duration_sec FROM pitStops ps JOIN drivers d ON ps.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985 GROUP BY d.driverId ORDER BY avg_duration_sec ASC LIMIT 3;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN res.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(res.driverId) AS completion_rate_pct FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.date = '1983-07-16';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results res WHERE res.raceId > 50 AND res.raceId < 100 AND res.statusId = 2 AND res.time IS NOT NULL;
SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix';
